name: duopore-public-study-route-compass
description: Compare study options using your own views on theory, practical work and flexible study time.

interface.longDescription: Compare study options using your own views on theory, practical work and flexible study time. Rate those three areas and choose how much each matters for each route. See how the scores add up, including ties. For adults exploring their own study choices. This is a way to compare your preferences, not a test of ability or a school admission decision.
defaultPrompt: Compare these study routes using my own preferences.
Show how theory, practical work and flexible time affect my scores.

review.commerce_description: Free useful computation. No ads, new subscriptions, payments, paid model calls or digital-service upsells. Separate commercial hypotheses are internal planning only.
